name: test_assembly
note: 3-part UCS2 (Cyrillic) concatenated deliver. Asserted: fragment 1 and 2 return NULL, 3rd completes; a partial assembly is dropped by sms_assembly_expire(now+40); re-preparing the assembled text with sms_text_prepare("555", text, ref, use_16bit=TRUE) yields 3 segments whose decoded text equals the original.
